column1: # Title: U.S. Major Sector Total Factor Productivity and Input Measures
# Private Business and Private Nonfarm Business – March 19
# Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS)
# Program: Multifactor Productivity (MFP) / Total Factor Productivity Program
# - Real value-added output: Sectoral real output measured at constant prices.
# - Capital input: Flow of aggregate services derived from physical capital assets.
# - Labor input: Quality-adjusted labor input (Hours Worked x Labor Composition).
# Citation: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. "Total Factor Productivity and Related Measures."
#           U.S. Department of Labor. Accessed October 2026.
